title: AI 日报/晨报一键生成播客站：网页能看、双语能听、RSS 可订阅，每日自动上线
subtitle: 一句话做出可看·可听·可订阅的行业晨报站，中英双语播客+RSS+每日自动更新，小白零门槛
description:
把「一份每天更新的简报」变成一个可以看的网页、可以听的中英双语播客、可以订阅的 RSS 节目，并配好每日自动更新——你只需说清内容来源、主题名称和发布方式，剩下的交给这个 skill。

交付内容：单文件 HTML 仪表盘、中英双语 mp3、RSS 订阅源、GitHub Actions 定时上线，以及一整套踩过坑才有的容错处理。适合做行业晨报/日报站、把文章或 newsletter 转成播客、想让内容每天自动发布并被小宇宙/Apple Podcasts 订阅的人。按技术能力分三档：本地站零门槛、在线站可分享、可订阅站全自动。

触发关键词：AI 日报 / 晨报网站 / 新闻播客 / 日报仪表盘 / 把文章变成播客 / daily brief site

#{播客} #{日报} #{自动化}
prompt:
帮我做一个每天更新的行业晨报站，主题和数据源我会告诉你。要求：
1. 生成一个单文件 HTML 仪表盘：顶部 Hero 展示日期与概览，中部锚点导航，正文卡片网格，内联 CSS/JS、响应式、无外部资源
2. 按 5 个固定版块整理内容，全局连续编号，来源 chip + 中文摘要 + 原文跳转
3. 用 text-to-speech 生成中英双语 mp3，含 90 秒速览，前端可在线播放
4. 生成 RSS 播客 feed（含 enclosure），可被小宇宙/Apple Podcasts 订阅
5. 配好每日自动更新（GitHub Actions + 定时兜底），避开 cron 整点高峰
6. 按我的技术能力选交付档位：本地站（零门槛）/ 在线站（可分享）/ 可订阅站（全自动）

en.title: AI Daily Brief to Podcast Site: Readable Web, Bilingual Audio, RSS Feed, Auto-Published
en.subtitle: Turn any brief into a site you can read, listen to and subscribe to — bilingual podcast + RSS + daily auto-update, beginner-friendly
en.description:
Turn a daily-updating brief into a webpage you can read, a bilingual Chinese-English podcast you can listen to, and an RSS feed people can subscribe to — with daily auto-publishing wired in. You only specify the content source, topic name and publishing preference.

Delivers: a self-contained HTML dashboard, bilingual mp3 audio, an RSS feed, GitHub Actions scheduled publishing, and battle-tested fallbacks. Ideal for industry morning-brief sites, turning articles or newsletters into podcasts, and recurring content subscribers follow in Apple Podcasts or Xiaoyuzhou. Three tiers by technical skill: local site (zero setup), shareable online site, fully automated subscribeable site.

Trigger phrases: AI daily brief / morning brief site / news podcast / daily digest dashboard / turn articles into a podcast / daily brief site
en.prompt:
Build a daily-updating industry morning-brief site. Topic and data source will be provided. Requirements:
1. Self-contained single-file HTML dashboard: hero with date and overview, anchor navigation, responsive card grid, inline CSS/JS, no external resources
2. Group content into 5 fixed sections, global continuous numbering, source chip + Chinese summary + link to original
3. Generate bilingual Chinese-English mp3 via text-to-speech, including a 90-second quick brief, playable in-page
4. Generate an RSS podcast feed with enclosure, subscribeable in Apple Podcasts / Xiaoyuzhou
5. Wire up daily auto-publishing (GitHub Actions + scheduled fallback), avoiding cron on the hour
6. Choose the delivery tier by my technical skill: local site / shareable online site / fully automated subscribeable site
